channel.title: Curated Archive Product Feed
channel.description: Google Merchant Center product feed for Curated Archive fragrance decants.

item.title: Aventus 10J02 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 10J02 is all about its smoke, which comes through with an ashtray like character that makes the scent feel very bold and challenging. It is not the easiest batch to appreciate right away, since the smokiness has an acquired taste and leans more rugged than crowd pleasing. In the mid, the fragrance stays woody and smoky, then gradually softens into a creamy musk vanilla drydown that gives the batch a smoother and more comforting finish.

item.title: Aventus 12D01 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 12D01 opens with a distinct grilled pineapple note, as if the fruit has light charred marks, giving it a bold and memorable introduction. In the mid, the profile turns citrusy and earthy, adding depth and structure without losing freshness. The drydown reveals a smooth citrusy vanilla that feels refined and well integrated. The transitions between stages are seamless and satisfying, fully living up to the batch’s reputation, with the scent remaining clearly detectable even after 8 hours.

item.title: Aventus 12F01 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 12F01 is dominated by an intense, in your face smoke that immediately gives the fragrance a raw, almost burned woodland character. The smokiness is bold and uncompromising, yet it remains surprisingly wearable, showing the kind of refined and distinctive smoke that makes the original Aventus difficult to replicate. In the mid, a hint of fruitiness tries to come through, but the smoke stays firmly in control for nearly three hours before the scent finally softens into a musky vanilla drydown. It is a powerful and memorable batch that leans heavily into smoke while still ending on a smoother, more comforting finish.

item.title: Aventus 13ZZ01 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 13ZZ01 opens with a strong burst of fruity pineapple, paired with a pungent musk and a well judged touch of smoke that gives the scent both brightness and depth. In the mid, a subtle saltiness emerges alongside the smokiness, adding a slightly rugged and more textured character to the composition. As it dries down, the fragrance becomes more citrusy and musky, leaving a cleaner but still distinctive finish. Performance is solid, with around 2 hours of projection and about 5 hours on skin.

item.title: Aventus 14K01 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 14K01 is a stark departure from the modern fruity interpretations of Aventus, opening with a deep blend of earthy, mossy, and smoky notes that immediately signal a mature and authoritative character. The depth is striking, evoking a true time capsule effect that feels old-world and seasoned rather than playful. Despite the absence of a fruity opening, the Aventus DNA remains unmistakable, even recognizable to others. In the mid, a subtle pineapple note begins to surface, sharpened by assertive woods that add structure and edge. The drydown introduces a mix of saltiness, musk, and vanilla, grounding the fragrance into a powerful and long-lasting base. Performance is exceptional, with around 7 hours of projection and up to 20 hours of longevity.

item.title: Aventus 15R11 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 15R11 – A radiant expression of pineapple brightness, opening with sweet vibrancy before evolving into a refined woody signature. The iconic sweetness gently shifts into a softly zesty brightness reminiscent of fine lemon sorbet, wrapped in musk and dry woods. A confident, uplifting, and easy-wearing Aventus that brings optimism with subtle masculine structure.

item.title: Aventus 15X21 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 15X21 - An unapologetically woody interpretation of the Aventus DNA. The fruitiness remains understated, surrendering quickly to deep, assertive woods that command presence. As it settles, the fragrance mellows into a smooth musk-vanilla warmth, leaving behind a gentlemanly aura that resonates quietly but firmly.

item.title: Aventus 15Y11 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 15Y11 – Opening with a lightly earthy fruitiness, this batch immediately leans dry-woody and aromatic. Lemon and woods define the heart, giving it a clean and distinguished identity. As it matures on skin, a gentle pineapple-musk veil emerges with remarkable persistence even activating beautifully with post-shower steam. A quiet powerhouse with impressive staying power.

item.title: Aventus 16H01 1ml Decant
item.description:
Aventus 16H01 opens with a refined tart fruitiness that feels bright and composed rather than aggressive. The mid transitions into a fresh, citrus-forward profile that remains clean and airy, giving the fragrance an easy sense of movement and clarity. As it dries down, subtle woods emerge to provide balance and structure, preventing the composition from becoming too sharp or fleeting.
Overall, this batch leans toward the lighter side of the Aventus spectrum. It is smooth, approachable, and effortless to wear, making it a dependable option for daily use and warmer conditions without sacrificing the signature Aventus character.

item.title: Aventus 17S01 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 17S01 opens with a woody and earthy profile that immediately feels grounded and mature. As it moves into the mid, the woodiness becomes warmer and ambery, supported by a subtle touch of vanilla that adds smoothness. In the drydown, the scent shifts toward a citrusy, musky finish that lightens the overall composition. Longevity is strong, lasting around 11 hours on both skin and T shirt.

item.title: Aventus 17T01 1ml Decant
item.description: A refined and beautifully balanced interpretation of the Aventus DNA, 17T01 opens with a green-toned pineapple that feels fresh, natural, and effortlessly classy. As it settles, the fruit evolves into a smoother, richer pineapple accord with gentle sweetness, evoking depth without becoming candied. The drydown reveals a graceful fusion of vanilla and soft musk, creating an aura of subtly seductive sophistication. Long-lasting and elegantly composed, 17T01 delivers presence without aggression — a confident, modern classic with timeless appeal.

item.title: Aventus 17X01 1ml Decant
item.description: A refined and luminous interpretation of the Aventus style. The opening presents a crisp and uplifting pineapple brightness intertwined with a gentle wood undertone that feels clean and polished. As it transitions, the fragrance deepens with a sweeter pineapple nuance lightly accented by a delicate spark of bergamot for subtle energy and lift. The drydown reveals a soft veil of musk and quiet warmth, creating an elegant skin-close aura. Fresh, balanced, and effortlessly sophisticated — a scent that communicates clarity and class rather than volume or aggression.

item.title: Aventus 18D02 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus 18D01 opens with an overripe pineapple accord paired with light woods, giving it a rich but controlled introduction. As it moves into the mid, the profile becomes fruity and musky, maintaining a soft and understated character. In the drydown, a very subtle musky vanilla emerges on both skin and fabric, requiring close wear to fully appreciate. Even after 20 hours, the scent remains detectable on clothing, with occasional gentle wafts of projection.

item.title: Aventus 20J01 1ml Decant
item.description:
Aventus 20J01 presents a darker character, comparable in depth to 16M01, but with its own distinct personality. The opening is earthy and woody, immediately setting a more serious and grounded tone, with a noticeable inky nuance reminiscent of a pentel pen that adds an interesting, almost industrial edge. As it develops into the mid, the woody profile remains dominant, but a subtle vanilla nuance begins to surface, softening the darkness and adding quiet richness.
In the drydown, citrus and musk emerge to lift the composition, creating contrast against the earlier heaviness while maintaining the recognizable Aventus DNA. Notably, the scent shows strong persistence, with traces of the DNA lingering on the skin even after washing with soap, highlighting its tenacity and staying power.

item.title: TBGCO Captivate EDP 1ml Decant
item.description: Captivate EDP is similar to the permanent listing version, but this one stands out because of its well blended smoke accord. The smoke adds a darker and more textured layer to the fresh Aventus inspired profile, giving the fragrance more depth and personality without overwhelming its brightness. While the smokiness may come across stronger at first, it settles into something smoother and more wearable over time, making the overall composition feel more balanced. Compared with Extrait V1 and V2, this version feels more distinctive, as the smoke gives extra character to the freshness and makes the scent more dynamic.

item.title: TBGCO Captivate V1 1ml Decant
item.description: Captivate V1 opens with a syrupy pineapple accord wrapped in a noticeably musky character, giving this older bottle a deeper and more textured take on the Aventus inspired profile. The sweetness associated with the BR540 style DNA remains present and becomes more dominant in the mid, adding a rich and slightly airy sweetness that softens the composition. As it dries down, the musk becomes noticeable again, giving the fragrance a smoother and more mature finish. In this form, the added musk actually improves the scent, as it blends naturally with the Aventus style structure and gives it a more appealing depth.

item.title: TBGCO Temptation 1ml Decant
item.description: Temptation is an enticing fragrance built around a bold apple and burnt sugar combination that immediately gives it a rich, sweet, and attention grabbing character. The scent has a warm spicy edge that adds depth to the sweetness, making it feel more seductive and polished rather than simply sugary. Its strong projection makes it especially noticeable in enclosed spaces, while the overall profile feels smooth, inviting, and perfectly suited for date night.

item.title: TBGCO Serene 1ml Decant
item.description: Serene comes across to me as a smooth and calming blend of tea, neroli, mint, and a subtle aquatic touch, even if some of those nuances are not reflected in the official note breakdown. The combination gives the fragrance a clean, airy, and effortlessly laid back character that feels extremely easy on the nose. What stands out most is how soft and swabe the scent feels overall, leaning more into quiet freshness than sharp projection, though it also seems like the kind of fragrance that can make the wearer go nose blind fairly quickly.

item.title: TBGCO Eau Benite 1ml Decant
item.description: Eau Benite is a difficult fragrance to pin down by notes alone, coming across as a blend of fresh spicy nuances, soft white florals, and an airy incense character. The overall impression feels clean, uplifting, and subtly sacred, with a watery freshness that gives it the effect of holy water meeting the gentle smoke of church incense. It has the refined atmosphere of a newly built, upscale church, cool, polished, and quietly reverent, making it a fragrance that feels serene, spiritual, and distinctly church appropriate.

item.title: TBGCO Aventus Blanc 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus x Blanc opens with a fresh and ripe pineapple accord that feels soaked in water, brightened further by a clean neroli touch and a slight kick of saffron. The opening has a crisp and airy fruitiness that feels especially appealing, but as the fragrance develops, Blanc gradually takes over the composition. What begins as an Aventus led blend eventually settles into a soft, clean scent profile that resembles a freshly laundered duvet, making the overall impression smooth, comforting, and effortlessly elegant.

item.title: TBGCO Captivate Strawberry 1ml Decant
item.description: Captivate Strawberry is a bold quadbrid that blends Aventus, Cedrat Boise, BR540, and strawberry into a scent that feels both familiar and completely unusual at the same time. The pineapple accord carries a slightly candy like twist, giving it a fruity character that recalls strawberry candy while still sitting on top of the woody, musky, and airy structure underneath. The result is a highly unique fragrance that feels like Aventus reimagined with a vivid strawberry edge, combining bright fruitiness and sweetness in a way that stands out even against many niche compositions.

item.title: TBGCO Under The Influence w/o canna 1ml Decant
item.description: Under The Influence without canna opens on a cola and rum accord, lighter and less fizzy than Roja Enigma Parfum, leaning heavily on the boozy side. In the mid, the rum sweetness deepens with the cola, the composition reading intoxicating, almost evocative of a night of overindulgence. The drydown is a sweet, smooth boozy musk, the cannabis note absent for a cleaner wear. A bold, atmospheric cola rum gourmand.

item.title: Dua 1 and Only Poseidon 1ml Decant
item.description: The tobacco and amber warmth from the inspiration of The One is the perfect complement to the birch smoke and juicy pineapple that we know all too well from our inspired Aventus. Jasmine and rose mingle with the aroma of orange blossom to add variety and divergence to this most accordant inspired hybrid. Oakmoss and patchouli underpin the infrastructure of the blend for a finish that is as striking as the opening.

item.title: Dua 44 Shades of Cherry Poseidon 1ml Decant

A cozy, gourmand-leaning cherry-vanilla interpretation of the Poseidon theme: gentle, approachable, and softly seductive.

item.title: Dua Banana Cream Pie Cocktail 1ml Decant
item.description: A velvety and indulgent banana gourmand. Opens with the authentic scent of ripe banana flesh blended with rich cream and a whisper of boozy warmth. As it evolves, the creaminess fades into a muscovado-like depth, accented with golden-brown graham crust nuances. The drydown settles beautifully into a soft vanilla wafer tone reminiscent of Loacker Quadratini Vanilla. Comforting, delicious, and effortlessly playful.

item.title: Dua Butterbeer 1ml Decant
item.description: A whimsical scent for the imaginative and especially for the Harry Potter nostalgic at heart. The opening is a captivating mix of salted butter, sweet butterscotch sauce, and sparkling ginger ale effervescence. As it moves into the heart, the fragrance deepens into a darker, slightly bitter fizz with a warm oak undertone. The drydown becomes creamy and nostalgic, evoking vanilla ice cream drizzled with caramel. On clothing, it transforms into a rich root beer float aroma that lasts well into the next day. A delightfully unique fizzy gourmand.

item.title: Dua Choco Cherry Crumble Cake 1ml Decant
item.description: Choco Cherry Crumble Cake opens with a rich gourmand blend of chocolate, vanilla, and caramel, immediately setting a dessert-like tone. The mid remains largely consistent with the opening, but gains an added graham crumble nuance that gives the scent more texture and depth. In the drydown, the composition becomes more condensed and dense, retaining its sweet gourmand character, while the cherry note stays very subtle and only faintly detectable toward the very end.

item.title: Dua Chocolate Wafers & Coffee 1ml Decant
item.description: A comforting, café-like aroma with personality. After a brief rubbery top note that quickly evaporates, the fragrance opens into a nostalgic wafer scent: crisp, toasted, and subtly sweet, reminiscent of Nissin wafers wrapped in childhood. Light roasted coffee sits alongside, balancing the sweetness with aromatic depth. The mid is a softened creamy coffee tone, never too heavy. The drydown resolves into a smooth almond-cream finish. Balanced, calming, and warmly relatable.

item.title: Dua Elixir of Poseidon's Classic Pineapple 1ml Decant
item.description: Elixir of Poseidon’s Classic Pineapple delivers one of the best syrupy pineapple profiles I’ve smelled, opening with a deep, ultra-fruity pineapple accord wrapped in a sugary undertone, reminiscent of the rich syrupiness found in Parfums Vintage Intense The One. As it develops into the mid, the scent turns creamy and woody, closely echoing the character of Pegasus’ drydown with a subtle touch of jasmine. In the drydown, it settles into a sweet, musky skin scent that feels smooth, comforting, and well-blended.

item.title: Dua Gone Swimming in Jazz Club 1ml Decant
item.description: Gone Swimming in Jazz Club opens with a striking contrast of fizzy orange brightness from Afternoon Swim layered against the smoky depth of Jazz Club. The combination is bold and immediately attention grabbing, though it can verge on being dizzying, making it better suited for cold environments. As the fragrance develops, the composition quickly leans into the familiar character of Jazz Club, which remains dominant through the mid and into the drydown, resulting in a warm, smoky, and consistent finish.

As the fragrance develops, the composition quickly leans into the familiar character of Jazz Club, which remains dominant through the mid and into the drydown, resulting in a warm, smoky, and consistent finish.

item.title: Dua Heaven on Earth 1ml Decant
item.description: Heaven on Earth presents a rich combination of coffee and chocolate that runs consistently from the opening through the mid, creating a dense and linear profile. item.title: Dua Oh Damn! 1ml Decant
item.description: A decadent dessert-in-motion fragrance. The opening fuses chocolate and popcorn in an unexpectedly irresistible combination. The heart of the fragrance envelops you in salted caramel: luxurious, long-lasting, and addictively cozy. It earns its name, truly an “Oh Damn!” moment.

item.title: Dua Poseidon Jr. 1ml Decant
item.description: Poseidon’s Jr. (Poseidon’s 11Z01 x Poseidon’s Elixir 2.0) opens with a bright, fresh, syrupy pineapple accented by very minimal woods, giving a clean and vibrant first impression. As it moves into the mid, the woods stay restrained while a soft whisper of the Aventus signature vanilla slowly emerges, adding smoothness and balance. In the drydown, it settles into a woody, musky base with vanilla, coming across almost like light plywood wrapped in vanilla and musk 😆 Overall, it is a bright, easy-to-wear blend and a clear step up from MOD 1 (11Z01 x 13ZZ01).

This is Aventus interpreted through depth, nuance, and quiet confidence: smooth, classy, and charismatic.

item.title: Dua Poseidon's Elixir Remixed MOD 1 1ml Decant
item.description: Poseidon’s Elixir MOD 1, a combination of 11Z01 x 13ZZ01, opens with a strong salty, musky, and aquatic character that immediately dominates the top. As it moves into the mid, the intensity becomes more subdued but remains largely unchanged, with the fruity pineapple character of an Aventus batch being almost unrecognizable. In the drydown, the fruitiness of 13ZZ01 finally emerges, though it is still laced with lingering saltiness. Overall, the scent comes across as aggressive and overwhelming, to the point of being dizzying and unsettling.

item.description: Poseidon’s Imagined Cologne blends Aventus with the profile of Imagination, essentially adding a tea and ginger twist to the familiar Aventus DNA. item.title: Dua Supernova Cologne 1ml Decant
item.description: Supernova Cologne smells closer to Elysium Parfum Pour Homme than the Cologne version, since it gives off more of that juicy, slightly oriental character rather than a citrus forward freshness. Instead of leaning crisp and sparkling, the scent feels fuller and richer in a way that makes it come across deeper than expected for a cologne style release. Because of that, I find the 30 ml formulation more appealing, especially for its more noticeable citrusy top that gives the scent a brighter and fresher opening.

item.title: Local Niche TBGCO Blanc 1ml Decant
item.description: Blanc may share a similar clean linen style category on paper, but the actual scent comes across very differently. item.title: Niche Amore Mio 1ml Decant
item.description: Amore Mio opens with a soft mandarin orange and bergamot, bright but quiet. In the mid, a thick, creamy floral heart blooms across heliotrope, gardenia, jasmine, ylang ylang, violet, and rose, an oriental sweetness building underneath. The drydown is cacao, rum, vanilla, tonka bean, and sandalwood over a touch of cumin and saffron, a semi gourmand warmth that sits close to the skin. Performance is long, lasting all day with a soft intimate sillage.

item.description: Severo opens with a freshly cracked Coca Cola accord, rum and lime fizzing on top in a Cuba Libre cocktail effect. In the mid, smoky birch, davana, and black pepper temper the boozy sweetness, lending a green woody bitter edge that keeps it from going syrupy. The drydown is vanilla, white musk, and amber, smooth and dry. Refreshing, characterful, and surprisingly long after the cocktail opening.

item.title: Niche Mile High 58 1ml Decant
item.description: Mile High 38 is the perfect balance of simplicity and complexity. It opens with smooth, fruity pineapple reminiscent of Aventus, then gradually transitions into the dry, herbaceous immortelle facet associated with Sunshine Man. In the drydown, creamy whipped notes and blow-torched brown sugar emerge, echoing Bake. Notably, the creaminess leans more toward a sunscreen-like texture rather than a heavy gourmand or lactonic feel. This is my most successful blind buy and a true work of art.

item.title: Niche Bake 1ml Decant
item.description: Bake opens with a bright lemony note that quickly melts into a whipped cream accord. It evokes the memory of buttery, chewy fondant icing, the kind you’d secretly snack on as a kid, rather than traditional buttercream. As it dries down, the scent deepens into a caramelized brown sugar profile, reminiscent of a blow-torched crème brûlée. A standout gourmand and easily my favorite in the category.

item.title: Niche Pegasus 1ml Decant
item.description: Pegasus is a fragrance I initially found puzzling, questioning why anyone would want to smell like almond. Over time, it completely won me over. It opens with a creamy, metallic almond note before revealing a beautifully smooth sandalwood in the drydown. Elegant, comforting, and quietly confident, this scent suits someone accomplished yet humble, and can even work in daytime conditions with the right breeze.

item.title: Middle Eastern Riffs Freeze 1ml Decant
item.description: Riffs Freeze opens with an icy burst of lemon zest, spearmint, Calabrian bergamot, grapefruit, and a frosted snow accord. In the mid, an ice and ginger heart with tea and sage keeps the freshness sharp, leaning slightly menthol. The drydown is a clean Ambermax, peony, and cedar, dry and aromatic. Cool, energizing, and built for the heat.

item.title: Middle Eastern Tubbees Bubble Gum 1ml Decant
item.description: Bubble Gum opens with a bright, minty sweetness that can initially come across like a child's toothpaste, giving it a playful and slightly nostalgic freshness. After a closer smell, the scent shifts into something much more familiar, evoking the distinctly sweet, chewy character of classic Bazooka bubble gum. The result is a fragrance that feels fun, youthful, and candy like, with a sugary profile that leans heavily into childhood nostalgia.

The milk note is especially indulgent, dense and sweet without becoming nauseating, giving the fragrance a fuller and more comforting gourmand character.

item.title: Middle Eastern Afnan 9PM 1ml Decant
item.description: Ultra Male inspired. Afnan 9PM carries the highly addictive scent DNA of its JPG Ultra Male inspiration, built around a rich blend of lavender, cinnamon, and vanilla that feels sweet, warm, and instantly seductive. What makes it stand out is the way the pear note adds a distinct juicy smoothness, giving the fragrance a more unique and recognizable character. Rather than coming across as aggressively loud, it feels more intimate and controlled, with a softer presence that still projects.

item.title: Middle Eastern Rumz Al Rasasi 9325 Pour Lui 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus inspired. Pour Lui blends tangy lemon, sweet pineapple, and a light woody base into a highly wearable and easy to enjoy fragrance. item.title: Middle Eastern Dumont Nitro Black 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus inspired. Nitro Black Intense is a fruity, woody, and slightly smoky take on the Aventus style DNA, but what gives it a more distinctive edge is the subtle metallic nuance in the scent. That faint metallic touch adds an extra layer of sharpness and character, making it feel less straightforward and more interesting than a typical fruity woody composition. The result is a fragrance that still feels familiar in structure, yet stands out enough to have its own identity.

item.title: Middle Eastern Rayhaan Imperia 1ml Decant
item.description: Aventus inspired. Imperia opens with a strong lemony Aventus style DNA that may come across a little sharp at first, but the fragrance becomes far more rewarding as it develops. The mid and drydown reveal a richer pineapple character that feels almost jammy, musky, and woody, giving the scent more depth and appeal than the opening suggests. Once it settles, the composition feels smoother, fuller, and much more satisfying, with a refined fruity woody balance that makes it stand out strongly within this style of fragrance.

item.title: S&L Cacao Nibs 1ml Decant
item.description: Original creation. Cacao Nibs opens with an earthy, dry chocolate note that feels darker and more grounded at the start, then gradually softens into a creamier chocolate milk character through the mid. As it settles, the scent becomes warmer and more familiar, resembling a rich chocolate cake style fragrance with a smoother and sweeter finish. Its progression makes it appealing for chocolate lovers, especially with its impressive longevity, lasting around 15 hours on both skin and clothes.

item.title: S&L To Hide a Smoker 1ml Decant
item.description: Original creation. To Hide a Smoker EDP has a sweet, warm, and nostalgic cola profile that immediately brings to mind gummy cola candy, with a texture that feels soft, chewy, and almost sparkling. The tobacco note stays very subtle, adding only a faint depth in the background rather than pushing the fragrance into anything dark or heavy. Because of that, the scent remains highly wearable and easy to enjoy, leaning more into a cozy gourmand character with a playful cola sweetness. It lasts for more than 8 hours and stays consistently pleasing without becoming tiring.

item.description: Original creation. Carefree smells like fresh laundry linen with a watery, airy quality that makes it feel clean and light from the start. item.title: Inspired Warthog Stud 1ml Decant
item.description: Warthog Stud is a more wearable take on the DHI style DNA, especially for those who find the iris in the original too strong or overwhelming. It keeps that smooth, powdery, and slightly elegant character, but presents it in a softer and easier to wear way. The result is a fragrance that still feels polished and refined, while being more approachable and comfortable on the nose.

item.title: Inspired Warthog Patchouli Haven 1ml Decant
item.description: Warthog Patchouli Haven opens with a refreshing burst of bright orange citrus, giving the scent an energetic and inviting start. As it dries down, the fragrance turns darker, slightly bitter, and more earthy, with patchouli becoming the clear focus of the composition. The contrast between the lively citrus opening and the deeper patchouli base gives it a bold and satisfying character, making it especially appealing in colder weather where its richness can fully shine.

item.description: Warthog Hombre carries the Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Le Parfum DNA, the lavender vanilla combo recognizable from the first spray. item.title: Inspired Warthog Dark Elixir 1ml Decant
item.description: Dark Elixir is a lavender forward fragrance with the note staying prominent from the opening to the drydown, while honey and tobacco remain subtle but noticeable enough to add warmth and depth. The scent feels like a creative hybrid, combining the lavender and pear style smoothness of Ultra Male with the honey tobacco richness associated with Le Male Elixir. Even with those darker sweet elements, it stays controlled and wearable, giving the fragrance a balanced character that feels comforting, slightly seductive, and easy to wear without becoming too heavy.

item.title: Inspired Warthog Royal Cologne 1ml Decant
item.description: Royal Cologne is an Aventus Cologne inspired scent with a noticeably prominent ginger note that gives the fragrance a bright, spicy, and energetic freshness. The ginger stands out early and adds a crisp kick to the citrusy opening, making the scent feel more vibrant and lively than a typical fruity woody profile. Overall, it comes across as a fresh, clean, and modern fragrance with a sharper, more invigorating edge.

item.title: Inspired Warthog Cosmopolitan 1ml Decant
item.description: Cosmopolitan is a sweet and playful fragrance that blends a smooth almond note with a rich cherry accord, creating a scent that feels both charming and polished. Together, they create a classy fragrance with a refined gourmand appeal that feels youthful, stylish, and effortlessly attractive.

item.title: Designers LV Imagination 1ml Decant
item.description: Imagination opens with a bright citrus impression, but as it develops, the tea note becomes the true focus of the scent. Rather than being sharply fresh or heavily citrus driven, it feels smooth, airy, and refined, with the citrus serving more as a crisp opening lift than the main identity. item.title: Designers Tom Ford Neroli Portofino 1ml Decant
item.description: Transportive and invigorating, Neroli Portofino captures the cool breezes, sparkling waters and lush foliage of the Italian Riviera. item.title: Designers JPG Le Male 1ml Decant
item.description: Le Male is a classic minty tonka fragrance with a mouthwash like freshness that gives it a cool, clean, and slightly medicinal opening. The mint comes across as sharp and aromatic in a way that immediately recalls the brisk sensation of a strong blue mouthwash, but it is softened by the sweetness underneath so it never feels sterile or harsh. As it develops, the tonka adds warmth, creaminess, and a lightly sugary depth that rounds out the mint and turns that fresh opening into something more sensual and comforting. The result is a fragrance that feels both clean and seductive, with a signature balance of barbershop freshness and sweet warmth.

item.title: Designers JPG Ultra Male 1ml Decant
item.description: JPG Ultra Male carries a highly addictive scent DNA built around the rich blend of lavender, cinnamon, and vanilla, creating a sweet, warm, and seductive profile that feels instantly appealing. What makes it stand out is the way the pear note adds a distinct juicy smoothness that gives the fragrance a more unique and recognizable character, something many similar releases fail to capture. Rather than coming across as aggressively loud, it feels more intimate and controlled, with a softer presence that stays close to the skin and makes the scent feel less attention seeking and more effortlessly inviting.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Dendros 420 1ml Decant
item.description: Dendros 420 opens with a profile that sits somewhere between Irish Spring soap and an intensely green shampoo, delivering an immediate feeling of cleanliness and freshness. The fragrance has a pronounced cooling effect that feels incredibly relaxing, almost like stepping out of a cold shower after a long and exhausting day. The green facets give it a natural and uplifting character, while the soapy freshness keeps it familiar and easy to wear. There is something calming about the scent, as if it slows everything down and creates a peaceful atmosphere around the wearer. Refreshing without being sharp and comforting without being heavy, Dendros 420 excels as a feel good fragrance that leaves you feeling clean, rejuvenated, and mentally refreshed.

item.title: Prime Monkey New Prime Monkey Royal Zest 1ml Decant
item.description: Royal Zest opens with around ten minutes of nonstop fizz, capturing the sparkling sensation of bubbling and popping carbonation with impressive realism. Even after an hour, it still carries that familiar orange soda character, keeping the scent playful, vibrant, and true to its name. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a musky orange finish that feels softer and smoother while still retaining its citrus identity. It also performs surprisingly well on clothes, lasting around 10 hours. Note: current formulation, clear juice.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Poseidon 1ml Decant
item.description: Poseidon opens cool and oceanic, a mineral marine freshness lifted by a clear ribbon of mint. That icy top settles into a creamy heart, where the sharp edge of the water softens into something smoother and rounder on skin. The dry down stays fresh but gains a gentle musky cream that keeps it comfortable rather than clinical. It is a calm, blue toned scent for warm days, easy to wear and quietly flattering, though its cool character means it never asks for attention.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Planet Befall 1ml Decant
item.description: Planet Befall opens with a bright cascade of mandarin and orange over crisp bergamot, luminous and immediately uplifting. The heart turns aromatic and lightly spiced, neroli and soft pepper adding warmth and a little movement without weight. As it settles, a clean vetiver grounds the citrus, giving the fresh opening a woody spine that keeps it from feeling fleeting. This is a polished, sunlit fragrance for daytime and warmer weather, elegant in its simplicity, with the honest note that this bright style tends to sit closer to skin as it dries.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Cosmic 1ml Decant
item.description: Cosmic opens warm and inviting, orange blossom and bergamot dusted with cinnamon and cardamom, a spiced sweetness that feels almost edible from the first moment. The heart is all comfort, a rich bourbon vanilla folding into a nutty praline warmth that gives the scent its cozy, gourmand pull. The dry down settles into soft amber and creamy woods, sitting close to skin and quietly addictive. It is a cold weather crowd pleaser, sweet and easy to love, though anyone who prefers sharp or fresh compositions may find it too warm and dessert leaning.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Glaukos 1ml Decant
item.description: Glaukos is built to be liked, a soft, clean freshness that reads as fresh laundry and good manners more than anything loud. It opens light and bright, settles into a gentle soapy warmth, and never strays far from that easy, approachable feeling. The dry down is a quiet musky cleanliness, the sort of scent that suits a classroom, an office, or a first meeting. It is honest about what it is, an unfussy daily wear rather than a signature, so anyone chasing complexity will find it simple by design.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Ethereal Noir 1ml Decant
item.description: Ethereal Noir opens crisp and luminous, bright citrus threaded with the dry, elegant lift of black tea. The heart stays clean and airy, the tea note giving it a refined, almost transparent sophistication rather than any real darkness, despite the name. It dries into a soft woody musk with a touch of warm amber, close to skin and easy to live with. This is a versatile, uplifting scent that performs well in heat, and its lightness is the whole point, so anyone expecting a heavy noir from the title will find it far brighter than it sounds.

This is a versatile, uplifting scent that performs well in heat, and its lightness is the whole point, so anyone expecting a heavy noir from the title will find it far brighter than it sounds.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Nexus Ultra 1ml Decant
item.description: Nexus Ultra opens cool and sweet, a bright mint and lavender freshness lifted by juicy pear, crisp for a moment before the sweetness takes hold. The heart warms quickly, cinnamon and soft spice bridging into a smooth, syrupy vanilla that defines the scent's character. The dry down is warm amber and vanilla with a clean musk, sweet and long lasting on skin and fabric alike. This is a bold, unmistakably sweet crowd pleaser for cooler weather and nights out, and its candied heart is a signature you either love or leave rather than an everyday quiet wear.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Valor Reconstructed 1ml Decant
item.description: Valor Reconstructed is the crowned king of the Valor line, the fruity Aventus style DNA rebuilt from the ground up and polished into its most regal form. The familiar bright pineapple opening feels richer here, smoother and more composed, moving into a creamy, lightly smoky heart that carries the line's signature with more weight and confidence. It settles into a refined woody musk that lingers with quiet authority. This is the Valor to reach for when you want the family's character at its most complete, made for evenings and moments that deserve the better bottle.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Emperium 1ml Decant
item.description: Prime Monkey's reading of Azzaro The Most Wanted Parfum. It opens with cardamom over a warm bergamot, spicy and bright for only a moment before the sweetness arrives. An hour in a toffee and caramel accord takes the centre, rich but smooth rather than sticky, resting on amberwood. The drydown is warm and woody with the sweetness still glowing underneath. A cold weather crowd pleaser.

item.title: Prime Monkey Prime Monkey Royal Zest 1ml Decant
item.description: Royal Zest opens with around ten minutes of nonstop fizz, capturing the sparkling sensation of bubbling and popping carbonation with impressive realism. Even after an hour, it still carries that familiar orange soda character, keeping the scent playful, vibrant, and true to its name. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a musky orange finish that feels softer and smoother while still retaining its citrus identity. It also performs surprisingly well on clothes, lasting around 10 hours. Note: previous formulation, blue tinted juice.
